author: bardic-inspiration
name: Gilded Duelist
summary: A celebrated elven blademaster who fights as an art, stepping through the air between strokes.
description: The duelist's gilded rapier is a gift from a royal house and a debt to a dead rival. A duel with one is an honor, and most of the people who have had it describe it as brief.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text: The duelist has {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws it makes to avoid or end the {ref:condition/charmed} condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The duelist makes three Rapier attacks.

damage.condition: if the target has no creature other than the duelist within 5 feet of it

bonusActions.name: Fey Step
bonusActions.text: The duelist teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: *Trigger:* The duelist is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. *Response:* The duelist adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
